lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity white circular clusters arranged in roughly four horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity crossing horizontal rows, with high-luminance blobs centered at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Parallel linear features along the upper lateral surface exhibiting a sharp luminance transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated silhouette is visible in close proximity to the ventral surface of the pectoral fin.
